question: Can the current211-dimensional fixed Ridge reader select lower450s native costs when both training and heldout inputs use measured10s responses?
purpose: Diagnostic readability of the existing representation/model/data budget; not a deployable policy or source-transfer result.
dataset: Existing Jinan20states,10seeds,160native branches; no new simulation; previous cohorts unchanged.
features: Original211-dimensional PP differences unchanged. Replace predicted-state Phi by measured-state Phi for both reader-training and heldout inputs; retain t0/nominal fields.
model: Ridge alpha1; training-only weighted RMS, no centering/intercept; PP exact0, round12 ties preferPP then canonical action.
weights: Each training seed mass1;2states*7nonPP rows per seed. Each fold8training seeds,16states,112nonPP rows;2heldout seeds.
primary: Actual450s selected stopped-vehicle-sec/(450*controlled_lane_count), equalstates then equalseeds; report oracle-reader minusPP paired95%t interval(df9).
decision_rule: A negative paired95%t upper bound vsPP supports diagnostic readability only. Otherwise stop investment in this211D/alpha1/data-budget reader recipe, retaining uncertainty and all outcomes.
success_next_question: Can decision-time predicted action contrasts recover the measured-response choice advantage on separate development data? Source contribution requires a separate real-source/target-only/placebo comparison.
limits: Heldout true10s responses are unavailable at decision time. Data have already informed development. Failure does not rule out allshort-response methods; success does not establish deployment or source gains.
no_search: No feature,alpha,seed,horizon or threshold search; no retry or enlargement based on these results.
